title: AnySleep: a channel-agnostic deep learning system for high-resolution sleep staging in multi-center cohorts.
summary: Sub-30-second AnySleep staging revealed information associated with sleep apnea beyond standard 30-second labels in the held-out data. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
ai_technology: A channel-attentive U-Net estimated sleep stages at shorter timescales.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Study analyses on sleep apnea compare high-resolution staging with conventional epochs in the first preprint.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world benefit were not established by the reviewed study.
evidence.ai_role: A channel-attentive U-Net estimated sleep stages at shorter timescales.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
